readerCopy.body: Recognition can become a trap when success keeps rewarding the exact role that has stopped feeling honest enough to keep repeating. When the Sun squares Lilith, identity and autonomy create friction, making praise, responsibility, or approval highlight what has been edited out to preserve the valued version. The role can be working and still no longer fit the whole person inside it. Success becomes easier to judge once being rewarded is separated from the question of what still deserves to continue.
